tools.name: replicate_run
tools.description: Preferred tool to generate or create an image, or make/render a video, using a Replicate-hosted model; returns the output media URL(s). Use this for plain requests like 'generate an image of X' or 'make a video of Y' — you do not need the user to name a model. Pass exactly two arguments: `model` (a string) and `input` (an object). For image generation, set `model` to 'black-forest-labs/flux-schnell' and `input` to { "prompt": "<your description>" }. For video, set `model` to a text-to-video model (e.g. 'minimax/video-01') and raise `wait_seconds`. Example call: { "model": "black-forest-labs/flux-schnell", "input": { "prompt": "a single red circle on white" } }. Do NOT put the prompt at the top level — it MUST go inside the `input` object.

model.description: The Replicate model to run, as a single string. Use 'black-forest-labs/flux-schnell' for fast image generation (the default for images). Other valid forms: 'owner/name' (latest version), 'owner/name:version' (pinned version), or a bare 64-hex version hash. This is a string, NOT an object.

input.description: The model's input parameters, as an OBJECT. The text description MUST go under the `prompt` key — e.g. { "prompt": "a golden retriever puppy in a field" }. You may add other model-specific keys like `aspect_ratio`, `num_outputs`, `image` (an input image URL), or `seed`. Required key for image/video models: `prompt`.

examples.prompt: a single red circle on white
a neon city skyline at night

wait_seconds.description: Optional. Maximum seconds to wait for completion (default 120, max 600). Increase for long video jobs. Leave unset for image generation.
